description: React component for user profile page with friend request and logout functionalities.

classes.name: ProfilePage
classes.description: React functional component for displaying user profile, managing friend requests, and logout.

methods.name: onSendRequest
methods.description: Handles sending a friend request to the profile user.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and resets user state.

methods.name: getRelationshipStatus
methods.description: Determines the relationship status between current user and profile user.

methods.name: renderActionButtons
methods.description: Renders action buttons based on relationship status.
